agreement.name: Kinesiology - Physical Education Teaching Emphasis, B.A.

notes.content: Kinesiology - Physical Education Teaching Emphasis, B.A.

ABOUT THE MAJOR This emphasis is designed for students who would like to teach physical education in a single-subject setting within schools. Traditionally this has been in grades 7-12, but increasingly school districts are hiring physical education specialists for the elementary grades as well. Using California state guidelines, the emphasis has been designed to give students a broad content base in order to prepare students to enter into a teacher education program. EMPHASIS & TEACHER EDUCATION COREQUISITE COURSES Students in the Physical Education Teaching Emphasis will complete at least 19 units of emphasis electives. Students are strongly encouraged to complete the co-requisite courses listed below as part of their undergraduate programs. See catalog for details. **Agreement does not include all required courses for the major at FPU** This agreement lists courses that are prerequisites or may be completed prior to transfer to satisfy major requirements. All transfer courses must be completed with a grade of C- or better, and students must complete a minimum of 18 units in the major at FPU. Please contact an academic advisor to discuss the recommended sequence of courses, including courses that may count for both GE and major requirements. To view the full degree requirements, please refer to the Undergraduate Catalog: https://catalog.fresno.edu/index.php .
